confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are bounded estimates from crowd-sourced cost-of-living and price aggregators, several of them undated, so they are indicative rather than verified 2026 menu prices. Beer and cocktail have the most support, a Jan 2026 pub-beer average and a club cocktail average plus one published venue figure. The cappuccino anchor has weak support and no 2026 Manila figure. The wine glass has no direct glass price and is derived from the local beer relationship, cross-checked against a Feb 2026 house-wine bottle average. The inexpensive and mid-range meal anchors are scaled from fast-food and mid-range per-person estimates. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not from inspected booking pages or current listings, and are the least certain. The FX observation for 2026-10-15 was taken from a search snippet attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; I could not load that page directly, so it is not independently verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Restaurant and drink anchors are Manila-specific, based on aggregated price averages. The wine glass is derived from the Manila beer anchor, and accommodation is a holistic Manila estimate from general knowledge.
